steps.name: harden-new-climate-tidy
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 88ed0050cd4e87bc59057de7b607535f8e6f5a1a; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage2/climate-tidy-hardening-v2.py > /tmp/climate-tidy-hardening-v2.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/climate-tidy-hardening-v2.py; .venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --all-files || true; .venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --all-files; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-climate-tidy-gate
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests -R climate_v6_tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- lib/environment_control/src/climate/ClimateFeatureEncoder.cpp lib/environment_control/src/climate/ClimateTrendEstimator.cpp scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Enforce climate v6 readability gate'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
